A_mission_lifecycle.responsibilities: LevelBase handles spawn, exit, fail/complete, QuestManager objective string, card effect hooks. IsoMissionBase extends it: mission_definition-driven blockout, runtime spawn buckets, attempt state, validators.
A_mission_lifecycle.reusable_readiness: Strong reusable spine for iso blockouts; IsoMissionBase is very large and mixes Taco-named dialogue import with generic iso.
A_mission_lifecycle.dependencies: GameState, SceneManager, QuestManager, EventBus, MissionBlockoutValidator, mission_definition Resource
A_mission_lifecycle.missing_pieces: Dedicated MissionLifecycleController node vs monolithic IsoMissionBase; explicit retry/death hook that always calls _setup_runtime_systems.
A_mission_lifecycle.risks: Lifecycle spread across LevelBase fail/complete and IsoMissionBase _ready ordering; death may not re-run full runtime setup until scene reload (needs manual playtest).
A_mission_lifecycle.next_action: Extract thin MissionRuntimeCoordinator from IsoMissionBase; document when _reset_attempt_runtime_state runs.

B_objective_system.missing_pieces: Typed ObjectiveDefinition / step graph if desired; unified panel data source.
B_objective_system.risks: Duplicate paths between QuestManager and Iso internal objective dictionaries.
B_objective_system.next_action: Choose single source of truth for mission objectives before redesign merges.
